# DappGo

> Public Taiwan stocks, US stocks and US options research. Quotes may be delayed; research is informational, not personalized investment advice.

## Reading policy

Public search, reading and citation are permitted. Model training is not permitted. robots.txt declares search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no. These preferences do not enforce access controls or guarantee crawler compliance.

## Public Markdown guide

- [AI reading guide](https://dappgo.com/ai-guide.txt): plain-text Markdown, data identity, freshness and citation instructions

## Canonical latest pointers

- [Taiwan stocks](https://data.dappgo.com/v1/markets/tw/dashboard/latest.json)
- [US stocks](https://data.dappgo.com/v1/markets/us/dashboard/latest.json)
- [US options](https://data.dappgo.com/v1/markets/options/dashboard/latest.json)

Resolve data_url_v2 relative to https://data.dappgo.com/v1/markets/<market>/ (not the pointer's dashboard directory), then check payload data_hash matches pointer hash. Accept only the corresponding dashboard/data-*.json immutable path. Read report_date, schema_version, timestamps and coverage from the payload. HTTP 200 does not establish freshness, complete coverage or live prices. Do not guess immutable filenames or use a moving CDN alias as the primary publication identity.

## Limits

Only public read-only resources are advertised. This catalogue grants no login, trading, social publication, Git, SSH or server-operation permission. Native store availability is managed separately. No public MCP or WebMCP action endpoint is advertised. Static Markdown is available at the explicit guide URL; automatic Accept: text/markdown conversion is not enabled.
